scope: Finite disposition review of the 130 existing body-inventory observations. Enclosing source functions and relevant immediate conversion/retention paths were read; original findings remain verbatim in every row. Accepted as finite evidence for repository-owned retained domain/service boundaries on the recorded Darwin profile. Overall migration acceptance remains governed by the original P0/P1/G0-G7 requirements.
method: Read current source via ast-outline structure or exact symbols followed by narrowly scoped source excerpts.
Partitioned observations into disjoint package groups (40 core, 48 protocol/provider, 42 edge/storage), then reviewed all fragment records.
Preserved zero-based observation indices and exact original finding objects; checked count, uniqueness, equality, source existence and source hashes with lightweight JSON/file reads.
No tests, builds, compiler inventory rerun or runtime profiling were performed for this source disposition review; the prior complete role-policy gates remain separate evidence.

disposition_meanings.no_domain_retention: The observed open representation is not retained as any/interface{}/RawMessage in repository domain/service fields on the inspected path. Converted concrete strings, structs or closed JSON variants can retain its meaning; this does not mean all input data is discarded.
disposition_meanings.error_protocol_propagation: Recovered value is asserted to error. State-authority errors may propagate as the original wrapper; other panic values are dropped. This standard error protocol is not misreported as type-only text or as a domain dynamic-payload field.
disposition_meanings.propagated_without_domain_assignment: Cleanup immediately rethrows the original panic. The inspected cleanup path does not assign it to a domain/service field; arbitrary outer callers are not analyzed.
disposition_meanings.request_local_wire_retention: Wire input can survive across stream frames in the single-request adapter, is converted into typed input before model reply delivery, and the inspected stop path clears temporary buffers. Source size checks are recorded but no whole-process memory bound is claimed.
disposition_meanings.open: Would identify an unresolved retention path for which local source evidence is insufficient. No such unresolved repo-owned domain/service-field assignment was found in these 130 observations under the stated scope.

explicit_limits: No claim of whole-program caller/escape/interprocedural closure, arbitrary injected callback behavior, generic-instantiation closure, foreign implementation internals, or every possible error object graph.
No Linux, other OS/architecture/build-tag/CGO profile acceptance follows from this native Darwin inventory.
Three findings are actual cmd/cgo-generated runtime declarations read from the existing Go build cache; Go runtime internals were not audited.
JSON conversion into a closed recursive value can preserve unknown extension data. This review distinguishes representations and retention boundaries, not semantic schema completeness.
No total memory/RSS, archive size, total event count, recursive screening or whole-process resource bound is established; row-level unchecked notes preserve observed limitations.
The two prior resource stops and later completion-cohort validation remain separate existing evidence; this source review does not rerun, replace, combine coverage, or reinterpret them.
